run_iaprtc12_handler: run the iaprtc12_handler function to import the IAPRTC-12 multi-label image dataset from a zip archive
extract_labels_from_zip: extract image labels from the IAPRTC-12 dataset zip file using the extract_labels inner function
get_image_ids_from_mat: get training validation or testing image IDs from MATLAB mat files inside the dataset zip
filter_image_paths: filter image file paths to include only those belonging to the training or testing split
generate_split_generator: generate a data split generator for the IAPRTC-12 dataset using random_split_generator_into_splits_with_fractions
